9.text: “I don’t want them,” said Ta’lo. “Do you hear me, put on some dry clothes.

10.text: Then I will tell you something.” Ta’lo entered the inner room, took off his

13.text: together, with his shirt.¹ The father stands on the opposite side of the hearth.
